purpose: Explain workflow errors that Tab 2 should expose, including what they mean and what can happen if not corrected.
placement_reason: Stored under _project_reference/TAB_HELP so this is documentation/helper data only and does not change runtime behavior.
implementation_status_note: These items are defined in canon as errors that should be exposed. Most dedicated detectors are not yet frozen as implemented in Tab 1/Tab 2 code. This JSON is a beginner-facing explanation catalog to support a future help button.
display_lines: 1. Workflow step points to missing file - A button, command, or workflow document refers to a file that no longer exists.
2. Workflow step points to deprecated file - The workflow points to a file that exists, but it is old or no longer the active owner.
3. Button-to-action mismatch - The button label says one thing, but the connected function does another thing.
4. Step order dependency errors - A later step runs before the earlier step that creates its input.
5. Input/output contract mismatch - One step creates a file with one name or shape, but the next step expects another.
6. Output folder naming mismatch - Different parts of the workflow use different folder names for the same output.
7. Stale generated artifacts - Generated files are older than the source files or older than their inputs.
8. Missing validation step in workflow - The workflow creates output but does not check whether the output is valid.
9. Placeholder command misuse - Documentation shows a command with placeholders, but users may run it literally.
10. GUI state label mismatch - The UI does not clearly show the current loaded file, mode, or track.
11. Dual JSON track workflow mistakes - The workflow confuses canonical web-AI JSON with local-AI working JSON.
12. Route manifest ignored by upload workflow - The splitter creates a route guide, but the upload instructions do not include or use it.
13. web_ai_readme ignored by workflow - The complete JSON has a guide explaining which sections answer which questions, but the workflow does not tell AI to use it.
14. Missing deterministic route for AI question types - The workflow lacks a clear rule for which file or JSON section to inspect for common question types.
15. Broken local-AI Ask flow - Tab 7 sends a question, but the evidence, deterministic path, streaming path, or final answer handling breaks.
16. Workflow step does not expose enough logs - A step fails or succeeds without showing enough information to verify what happened.
17. Workflow step cannot be rerun idempotently - Running the same step twice changes things in unsafe or confusing ways.
18. Workflow references old validation logic - The workflow still calls an old validator that does not know the current contract.
19. Missing rollback or fail-safe workflow - A failing step damages or replaces the last good output instead of preserving it.
20. Workflow documentation drift - Documentation says the workflow works one way, but code works another way.
21. Missing cross-project generalization - The workflow only works for developer_tools and fails on other projects.
22. Workflow assumes wrong encoding or line endings - A workflow reads files using the wrong text encoding or assumes one line-ending style.
23. Workflow silently succeeds with empty output - A step says it worked, but the output is empty, tiny, or missing required content.
24. Declared dependency vs installed dependency version skew - The project says it needs one dependency version, but the environment has another.
25. Path root drift - The workflow is run from one folder but reads or writes as if it were in another folder.
